Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler on my side is refused, with an error saying it needs gateway credentials. So nothing is scheduled, and no digest will post next Monday (19 Oct) unless that's fixed.

You're a member of both #coastal-team and #coastal-random, so I'm allowed to read both for you. Once scheduling works, the plan is a job at 08:00 Chicago time every Monday, starting 19 Oct. It would read last week's messages in those two channels plus any customer items still open, and post one "Coastal week ahead" message here. It would leave out finance figures and anything from other channels or DMs.

Someone with gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler credentials, or set up the job from the Automations page. I can also post a digest by hand each Monday until then, or run one now if you'd like to see the format.
